metadata.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
skinparam class {
    BackgroundColor LightSkyBlue
    BorderColor RoyalBlue
    ArrowColor RoyalBlue
}

class User {
    +id: String
    +username: String
    +password: String
    +role: String
    +fullName: String
    +email: String
}

class Student {
    +studentCode: String
    +className: String
    +avatarUrl: String
    +faceEmbedding: String
}

class Room {
    +id: String
    +roomCode: String
    +name: String
    +capacity: int
}

class Subject {
    +id: String
    +subjectCode: String
    +name: String
    +credit: int
}

class Camera {
    +id: String
    +cameraCode: String
    +name: String
    +ipAddress: String
    +location: String
    +status: CameraStatus
}

class ExamSession {
    +id: String
    +startTime: Date
    +duration: float
    +mode: ExamMode
}

class ExamSessionCamera {
    +id: String
    +videoPath: String
}

class ExamSessionDetail {
    +id: String
    +status: ExamStatus
    +seatNumber: String
    +note: String
}

class Model {
    +id: String
    +name: String
    +precision: String
    +recall: String
    +f1Score: String
    +status: String
    +modelPath: String
}

class ModelSample {
    +id: String
    +type: String
}

class Sample {
    +id: String
    +name: String
    +dataPath: String
}

class ModelStatistic {
    +totalSamples: int
    +cheatingDetections: int
}

class RecognitionResult {
    +id: String
    +violationType: ViolationType
    +confidence: Double
    +detectionTime: String
    +detail: String
    +imageUrl: String
}

' Relationships
User <|-- Student : extends
Model <|-- ModelStatistic : extends

ExamSession "1" o-- "0..*" ExamSessionDetail : aggregates
ExamSession "1" o-- "0..*" ExamSessionCamera : aggregates
ExamSession "1" o-- "1" Room : has
ExamSession "1" o-- "1" Subject : has
ExamSession "1" o-- "1" Model : uses

ExamSessionCamera "1" o-- "1" Camera : aggregates
ExamSessionDetail "1" o-- "1" Student : aggregates

Model "1" *-- "0..*" ModelSample : composition
ModelSample "1" o-- "1" Sample : aggregates

RecognitionResult "1" o-- "1" Model : uses
RecognitionResult "1" o-- "1" ExamSessionCamera : uses

@endum",
  "config": null
}

{"data": "@startuml
skinparam class {
    BackgroundColor LightGoldenRodYellow
    BorderColor DarkGoldenRod
    ArrowColor DarkGoldenRod
}

class users {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +username : VARCHAR(255) [UNIQUE]
    +password : VARCHAR(255)
    +role : VARCHAR(255)
    +full_name : VARCHAR(255)
    +email : VARCHAR(255)
}

class students {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK, FK]
    +student_code : VARCHAR(255) [UNIQUE]
    +class_name : VARCHAR(255)
    +avatar_url : VARCHAR(255)
    +face_embedding : TEXT
}

class rooms {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +room_code : VARCHAR(255) [UNIQUE]
    +name : VARCHAR(255)
    +capacity : INT
    +building : VARCHAR(255)
    +description : VARCHAR(255)
}

class subjects {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +subject_code : VARCHAR(255) [UNIQUE]
    +name : VARCHAR(255)
    +credits : INT
    +department : VARCHAR(255)
}

class cameras {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +camera_code : VARCHAR(255) [UNIQUE]
    +name : VARCHAR(255)
    +ip_address : VARCHAR(255)
    +location : VARCHAR(255)
    +status : VARCHAR(255)
}

class models {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +name : VARCHAR(255)
    +precision : VARCHAR(255)
    +recall : VARCHAR(255)
    +f1_score : VARCHAR(255)
    +status : VARCHAR(255)
    +model_path : VARCHAR(255)
}

class samples {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +name : VARCHAR(255)
    +data_path : VARCHAR(255)
}

class model_samples {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +type : VARCHAR(255)
    +sample_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +model_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
}

class exam_sessions {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +start_time : DATETIME
    +duration : FLOAT
    +mode : VARCHAR(255)
    +room_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +subject_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +model_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
}

class exam_session_cameras {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +video_path : VARCHAR(255)
    +camera_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +exam_session_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
}

class exam_session_details {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +status : VARCHAR(255)
    +seat_number : VARCHAR(255)
    +note : VARCHAR(255)
    +student_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +exam_session_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
}

class recognition_results {
    +id : VARCHAR(36) [PK]
    +violation_type : VARCHAR(255)
    +confidence : DOUBLE
    +detection_time : VARCHAR(255)
    +detail : VARCHAR(255)
    +image_url : VARCHAR(255)
    +model_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
    +exam_session_camera_id : VARCHAR(36) [FK]
}

' Relationships
users <|-- students : "extends"
samples "1" -- "0..*" model_samples : "has"
models "1" -- "0..*" model_samples : "has"
rooms "1" -- "0..*" exam_sessions : "holds"
subjects "1" -- "0..*" exam_sessions : "has"
models "1" -- "0..*" exam_sessions : "uses"
cameras "1" -- "0..*" exam_session_cameras : "monitors"
exam_sessions "1" -- "0..*" exam_session_cameras : "records"
students "1" -- "0..*" exam_session_details : "assigned"
exam_sessions "1" -- "0..*" exam_session_details : "includes"
models "1" -- "0..*" recognition_results : "classified by"
exam_session_cameras "1" -- "0..*" recognition_results : "captured"

@endum", "config": null}
